result_tail:
t explains the "noise earlier, nobody filed a report" — it was short enough to self-resolve before anyone noticed. Three independent lenses (infra-process, interfaces, software-defect) converged on the same read, and an adversarial judge pass validated the degradation-switch hypothesis while invalidating code-defect and gateway/boundary alternatives.

Two noted gaps (don't change the verdict): couldn't verify at the source-code level that no other defect path could also emit 503, and didn't independently confirm there's no gateway tier beyond the lab's own documentation saying there isn't one.
